games.title: Matter Sorter
games.skillName: Grouping everyday materials as solids, liquids or gases
games.statutoryRequirement: Pupils should be taught to compare and group materials together, according to whether they are solids, liquids or gases
games.instruction: Compare the materials, then tap the right answer.
games.hint: Not quite. Ask yourself: does it keep its shape, pour, or spread out to fill the space?

questions.ask: Which of these is a gas?
Which of these is a liquid?
Which of these is a solid?
Sand can be poured, but each grain keeps its shape. What is sand?
Which gas makes the bubbles in a fizzy drink?
Which of these is a liquid that pours very slowly?
Which of these spreads out to fill any container it is in?
Which group do milk, water and cooking oil all belong to?
Which group do steam, air and helium all belong to?
Which group do ice, flour and a coin all belong to?

games.title: Next Step Scientist
games.skillName: Using results to predict, improve and ask new questions
games.statutoryRequirement: Pupils should be taught to use results to draw simple conclusions, make predictions for new values, suggest improvements and raise further questions
games.instruction: Look at the results, then tap the best next step.
games.hint: Not quite. Look for the pattern in the results, then try again.

questions.ask: A plant grew to 2 cm, 4 cm, then 6 cm in weeks 1 to 3. Predict week 4.
A ball bounced 20 cm when dropped from 50 cm, and 40 cm from 100 cm. Predict for 150 cm.
A car rolled 1 m off a 10 cm ramp and 2 m off a 20 cm ramp. Predict for 30 cm.
A room was 15 °C, 17 °C, 19 °C and 21 °C at 9, 10, 11 and 12 o'clock. Predict 1 o'clock.
Sugar dissolved fastest in the warmest water tested. Predict for even hotter water.
Mia tested each paper towel only once. How could she improve her test?
Sam poured a different amount of water on each towel. What should he change?
Results were 3 cm, 3 cm, 9 cm and 3 cm. Which result should be checked again?
Which change would make timings in a test more accurate?
After an ice-melting test, which is a good further question to test?
